text.description_html:
Yale 6170P36 36 Inch Surface Vertical Rod with Electric Latch Retraction

The Surface mounted vertical rod touch bar exit device is for use used on wide stile and flush doors up to 10 feet where one- or two-point latching is desired.

These vertical rod exit devices are handed for doors 36" wide. This exit device is certified ANSI/BHMA A156.3 type 2 Grade 1 standards.

Features and Specifications of the Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Electric latch retraction
  • Exterior Trim: None
  • Latchbolt: Top: 3/4" (19mm) pullman style with auto deadlatching; Bottom 5/8" (16mm) deadbolt, held retracted during door swing
  • Vertical Rods: 1/2" OD brass, bronze or stainless steel with rod guides.
  • Strike: Top: 626; Bottom: flush-mounted 790. 794 floor strike optional (threshold openings)
  • Projection: 3-1/4" (83mm) active; 2-1/2" (63.5mm) dogged
  • Stile: 4-1/2" minimum
  • Handing: Handed
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: 36"
  • Door Height: 7' standard.
  • Fasteners: Machine screws or wood door screws .
  • Dogging: hex key
  • ANSI A156.3 Grade 1

Special Factory Order. No Returns
